overview: America's unique form of democracy separates power among three branches of government: the legislative, judicial and executive. As the head of the executive branch, the president of the United States is the country's most visible and important leader, both at home and abroad. Join HISTORY for a fresh perspective on how the Oval Office has evolved over the past 200 years through stories about the 43 men who have served as commander-in-chief. This eight-hour miniseries concentrates on the ebbs and flows of presidential power and responsibilities as each of America's leaders deal with the events, expectations and challenges of his time.
title: The Ultimate Guide to the Presidents

overview: In a blood-soaked encounter at a banquet, the Chu siblings are ruthlessly pulled into the whirlpool of fate. His right arm stained with blood, her tears falling onto old wounds, a fleeting kiss like a sudden bloom—brief yet unforgettable. However, the chains of ethics force them apart, and the flames of war ultimately separate them. A year later, Jiang Yichen uses an engagement as his weapon, closing in step by step, vowing to utterly destroy the Chu family. Yet, even the powerful are not immune to temptation! The young military commander willingly submits to her, kneeling beneath her cheongsam, ready to serve her. Meanwhile, a false brother betrays the ethical bonds that once held them, tearing apart all moral boundaries. The forbidden sparks of a love triangle between him and Jiang Yichen ignite, throwing their relationships into chaotic turmoil. She struggles in a web of conspiracy, her hairpin stained with blood and her white gown torn. Stumbling into his arms on a cold night, every step she takes is heavy with hardship, yet the abyss of fate has already opened. As hidden truths are revealed, bloodline lies, enemy communications, and foreign plots push all three toward the edge of life and death. Their destinies are already intertwined, and escape is impossible.
title: Love in Turbulence

overview: Tastefully Yours depicts the story of Han Bum Woo, the successor of a large food company, who runs the best fine dining restaurant in Seoul but has no interest in 'taste', and Mo Yun Joo, a chef crazy about 'taste' who runs a one-table restaurant without a sign in a remote corner of the countryside. They grow together and fall in love while running a small restaurant in the city of Miraek, Jeonju.
title: Tastefully Yours

overview: Jiang Yingwan loved Rong Shiqing, but was caught in a dilemma because of Pei Yanchen's persistent pursuit. After many conflicts and misunderstandings, she recognized her feelings for him under the protection of Pei Yanchen. But Rong Shiqing reappeared, making this relationship face more challenges.

overview: The Legion of Extraordinary Dancers, also known as The LXD, is a web series about two groups of rival dancers: heroes (The League of Extraordinary Dancers) and villains (The Alliance of the Dark) who discover they have superpowers, referred to as "the ra", through their dance abilities.

overview: Due to her striking resemblance to her stepsister, Mu Zixue is forced to consummate the marriage in her sister's place with the powerful warlord. But little do they know, the seemingly innocent heroine is actually a cunning mastermind. Beneath her gentle exterior lies a black lotus with a secret mission—avenging her mother. Determined to rise from a mere "bed substitute" to the true wife of the warlord, she vows to win his love and take everything from her stepmother and stepsister. In the end, she achieves her revenge and makes a dazzling comeback.
title: Her Perfect Replacement

overview: Toxic follows Chambers as she draws from her experience and background as an investigative journalist to delve into the dark and twisted side of relationships. Through conversations with survivors from across the country, Chambers brings viewers into the raw and real stories of those affected by destructive relationship dynamics, showcasing the lasting trauma and tragedy that can result from unhealthy relationships.
title: Toxic

overview: Wu Ming, the heir of a traditional Chinese medicine family, descends the mountain to save his fiancée's life. Unexpectedly, he encounters the ailing Chairman of the Yang Group, who's offering a hundred million for a cure. Wu Ming's journey is filled with challenges and opportunities, attracting the attention of several beautiful women. How will he navigate these temptations?

overview: Restaurateurs who are looking for a quick fix or social media glow-up are in for the surprise of their lives when famed culinary titan Gordon Ramsay trades his signature chef knives for a state-of-the-art surveillance vehicle and cutting-edge spyware in FOX's all-new unscripted series, Gordon Ramsay's Secret Service. In a Gordon Ramsay series first, Chef Ramsay will venture into struggling restaurants under the cover of night. With the help of a secret source on the inside, he'll gather raw, unfiltered evidence and get a 360-degree view of the major issues facing each restaurant. This insider will not only remain a secret to the staff, but will also help Ramsay infiltrate the restaurant after-hours for a dramatic nighttime black light kitchen investigation that reveals more filth and grossness than ever before. By the time Ramsay reveals his identity, it will be too late for staff to cover up their culinary crimes. Gordon Ramsay's Secret Service will be his toughest assignment yet as he takes drastic measures to transform not only the restaurant but also the staff, because Gordon knows he can upgrade the menu and renovate the restaurant, but the most important change has to come from the people. Are the restaurant and staff willing to accept Gordon's mission, or are they too far gone to be saved?
title: Gordon Ramsay's Secret Service

overview: Get ready to sashay and sauté with the new restaurant revamp lifestyle series, DRAG BRUNCH SAVED MY LIFE. The series showcases world-renowned drag superstar, Priyanka, as she and a team of culinary connoisseurs visit restaurants across Ontario, helping transform their businesses with all-new vibes, and culminating in the ultimate drag brunch extravaganza.
title: Drag Brunch Saved My Life

overview: New Orleans, 38 months after Hurricane Katrina: Barack Obama has just been elected to the White House, giving this battered, majority-black city reason for optimism. Yet for every entrenched resident who hopes to improve his or her lot - or just return to a sense of pre-Katrina normalcy - others are intent on capitalizing on the city's vulnerability and suffocating its culture.
title: Treme

overview: Set in contemporary London with a British Metropolitan Police Officer at its heart, Marcella is Scandinavian noir on the streets of Britain. Told with Rosenfeldt's unflinchingly clear Nordic style, full of hooks and action, The series will lead the audience through a narrative maze until the final moments of the drama. Marcella will also delve into the psychology of a single female detective working solo on a serial murder case with many potential suspects and victims. Returning to the Met's Murder Squad after a 12-year career break, Marcella Backland is a detective in her late 30's who gave up her fast-tracked role to marry and devote her life to starting a family. With the abrupt end to her marriage to the love of her life Jason and isolated from her daughter at boarding school, Marcella returns to work whilst attempting to make sense of what's happened in her life.
title: Marcella

overview: Sky is bringing NBC's legendary late-night comedy showcase, Saturday Night Live, to the UK and Ireland in 2026. A star-studded lineup of hosts will take to the stage to declare, "Live from London, it's Saturday Night!" in this brand-new edition of the programme.
title: Saturday Night Live UK

overview: Behind the scenes of the world-famous Longleat House and Gardens as it celebrates 75 years open to the public. Lord and Lady Bath grant unprecedented access to their stately home and safari park as we meet a wide selection of the 600 people who work there - from animal keepers to cleaners, gardeners to cooks, historians to handymen -as well as many of the estate's 1000 animals, including lions, rhinos, red pandas and koalas.
title: Inside Longleat
The Seventh Chapter of the Night

overview: Each episode in this sumptuous travel series showcases one of Europe's most extraordinary train journeys, highlighting beautiful natural landscapes, local heritage, regional cultures and, of course, the sheer ease and joy of this fast and eco-friendly mode of transport. overview: Bob Stewart's popular game show franchise includes "The New $25,000 Pyramid" with Dick Clark hosting a daily daytime broadcast for CBS. Since Bob Stewart packaged a weekly syndicated Pyramid game show with the same amount, and because of the winnings limit for the network, the Subsequent Syndicated Spinoffs awarded an even higher amount, via a tournament of champions. At the same time, CBS continued to order more episodes through 1988.
title: The $25,000 Pyramid

Her sister, Rose, becomes a vengeful demon, lurking in the labyrinth of power and desire of the ruthless businessman, Chen Zi'an. With seduction as her blade and intelligence as her sheath, she carefully dismantles the web of lies. The trampled heart will turn into thorny vines, entwining into an unbreakable crown, declaring that a woman's redemption always lies in her own hands.

overview: Impossible odds are part of the job. By 1942, severely weakened by the Nazis, the Allies implemented a daring new strategy for waging war. Their disruptive technique was to attack Hitler's Reich from within. Featuring the minute-by-minute accounts of the brave soldiers who crossed deep into enemy territory, Commando Missions recounts these heroic top-secret operations. In four spellbinding episodes that blend spectacular reconstructions with archives and animation, this premium series chronicles how these highly-trained guerrilla fighters slipped behind enemy lines to bring the German war machine to its knees. The near-impossible missions include: the upstream paddling expedition to disable German warships in Bordeaux; the six-man mission to destroy the Luftwaffe fleet at Heraklion; and, the deadly polar trek to take out an occupied Norwegian hydroelectric plant.
title: Commando Missions

overview: Every year, millions of students and young adults migrate to southern beaches and tropical destinations to decompress and let loose. For many, this is their first brush with independence – no parents, no rules, just a weeklong party. Spring Break Murders reveals the untold stories lurking beneath the sun-soaked surface of the most popular holiday destinations. Found brutally murdered on their vacations – students and young people are the collateral damage. Across the series, we expose the unseen threat facing millions of youth – surfacing tragic cases and uncovering the negligence of caretakers and local authorities. This is a parent's worst nightmare.
title: Spring Break Murders

overview: One of Cheshire's best-loved and longest-standing Housewives, Tanya Bardsley lifts the lid on the chaos of her home life in the hilarious new reality format. Andrew refers to the events that took place 10 years ago when he got acquainted with a man who was in the crosshairs not only by Russian, but also foreign intelligence services... Now, to save his good name, Voronov should not only survive in the...

overview: At the Royal Blackburn Hospital, the critical list team juggle urgent life or death cases as they come through the door. It's up to the staff to decide who will go next into Theatre 6, the only operating room dedicated to unplanned emergency procedures.

overview: This brand-new programme follows luxury property developer Guy Phoenix's rollercoaster journey of buying and renovating a £16million Monaco apartment: the biggest investment and financial risk that Guy has ever taken. His maverick methods, creative genius and unrelenting self-belief have seen him climb to the top of the luxury property ladder in the UK, but Guy sees these as small steps towards his ultimate goal - to build the most expensive and luxurious house in the world! And what better place to begin his mission to conquer the luxury property world than Monaco - one of the most expensive and desirable places to live on the planet. We follow the highs and lows of every aspect of this unique renovation that has Guy's entire reputation at stake. As the finish line gets closer, the pressure and stress on Guy and his crack team of builders becomes almost unbearable. If all goes to plan, his grand vision to build the world's most expensive house will be a step closer. Get it wrong and, well... Guy doesn't even think about that!
title: Building Monaco's Superhomes

overview: In Before The Coffee Gets Cold, in the heart of Japantown, San Francisco, a family-owned café offers more than just coffee—it serves as a bridge between past and present. Visitors line up, drawn by the chance to relive a moment that changed their lives, knowing they must return before their coffee grows cold. Though the past cannot be rewritten, the act of letting go in the present can open the door to a future filled with hope. But this barista family, whose selfless gift has brought solace to so many, must now confront the shadows of their own mysterious past—one that may cost them everything.
title: Before The Coffee Gets Cold

overview: This story follows the sweet and "overprotective" newly-wed life between Someya Yukito, a young master of an established inn in Asakusa, and Tsuruoka Io, a pure-hearted female apprentice training to be a chef. Tsuruoka was in the depths of despair until she found solace in the sweet konpeito candy given to her by Someya. Since then, she has earnestly cherished her feelings while training as a chef. Yukito's affectionate words and actions reserved only Tsuruoka, along with his excessively cute jealousy, create an irresistibly heart-fluttering devotion with a charming gap that's impossible to resist!

After one such drink, he falls down on the street and is picked up by some unknown people. He wakes up shaved and chained to a post in an unknown location. Aman finds himself in the labor slavery of the cruel Kazbek. His henchmen are bringing in alcoholics and addicts from around the city. Kazbek first breaks the wills of his prisoners by keeping them in the scorching heat without food or water. Then he sends them out to work. Unwilling to accept their fate, Aman plots an escape.
Olga and Igor meet at a hospital and literally fall in love at first sight. Their overwhelming feelings for one another turn out to be stronger than their current commitments.

As the story unfolds, Diana realizes that it wasn't a dream, but a memory of a past life.
